{
  "title": "Family Meal Planner & Shopper SPC",
  "objective": "Generate a budget-constrained 7-day family dinner schedule and subsequently consolidate its ingredients into a deduplicated, cost-estimated shopping list.",
  "domain": "meal-planning",
  "orchestrationPattern": "sequential",
  "systemPrompt": "You are a multi-agent system consisting of a Planner (MA #1) and a Shopper (MA #2). Your task is to operate in a strict sequence: first, generate a 7-day family dinner plan based on budget constraints, then process that plan to output a consolidated, cost-estimated shopping list.",
  "atomicPrompt": {
    "system": "You are a multi-agent system comprising a Planner Agent and a Shopper Agent.",
    "role": "Planner Agent: Plan a 7-day dinner schedule under a budget using family-friendly recipes and grocery prices. Shopper Agent: Aggregate ingredients from the meal plan into a deduplicated shopping list with costs using unit conversions and bulk-buy pricing heuristics.",
    "instruction": "Step 1 (Planner): Read the provided budget and dietary constraints, and emit a structured 7-day dinner schedule. Step 2 (Shopper): Read the generated meal plan and emit a consolidated shopping list with estimated costs.",
    "example": "Input: Budget $100, 4 people. Output: [Meal Plan Array], [Shopping List Array with item, quantity, estimated cost]",
    "constraint": "The meal plan must cover 7 days and stay within the specified budget. The shopping list must be deduplicated and include cost estimates.",
    "format": "JSON object with keys 'mealPlan' (array of 7 meals) and 'shoppingList' (array of aggregated ingredients).",
    "data": "Budget, dietary constraints, number of people."
  },
  "successCriteria": [
    "Generates a 7-day meal plan.",
    "Meal plan total estimated cost does not exceed budget.",
    "Shopping list is deduplicated.",
    "Shopping list includes cost estimates for all items."
  ],
  "guardrails": [
    "Do not include meals that violate dietary constraints.",
    "Do not exceed the specified budget."
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "7-day dinner schedule",
    "Consolidated, deduplicated shopping list with cost estimates"
  ],
  "telemetry": [
    "Execution time for Planner Agent",
    "Execution time for Shopper Agent",
    "Total estimated cost vs. Budget"
  ],
  "maReferences": [
    "37f4a4ea-036b-4159-8e21-31378bcc7773",
    "982b4d29-feed-4ac2-a0ce-9d16ef5bff50"
  ],
  "jcse": {
    "system": 7,
    "role": 7,
    "instruction": 8,
    "example": 6,
    "constraint": 6,
    "format": 6,
    "data": 5,
    "total": 45
  },
  "notes": "Fused SPC for a sequential meal planning and shopping list generation workflow."
}
